time.justNow.description: Short relative time: less than a minute ago. Lowercase.

time.minutes.description: Short relative time: minutes ago. {count} is 1 to 59. Keep it very short; “m” stands for minutes.

time.hours.description: Short relative time: hours ago. {count} is 1 to 23. Keep it very short; “h” stands for hours.

time.days.description: Short relative time: days ago. {count} is 1 to 29. Keep it very short; “d” stands for days.

time.months.description: Short relative time: months ago. {count} is 1 to 11. Keep it very short; “mo” stands for months.

time.years.description: Short relative time: years ago. {count} is 1 or more. Keep it very short; “y” stands for years.

time.unknown.description: Short relative time when the time could not be read. Lowercase, one word.

time.recently.description: Stands in for a relative time inside a sentence when the time could not be read (“It joined recently”). Lowercase, one word.
